    First CourseSecond CourseThird CourseFourth Course
    First CourseJabba's palace crumbed prawn bitesPanko prawns, sweet chilli. Before Leia chokes Jabba with his own chainHow to make it500g green prawns, peeled100g plain flour2 eggs, beaten100g panko breadcrumbs1 L vegetable oil100ml sweet chilli sauce1 limeButterfly the prawns.Dip in flour, then egg, then panko.Fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C in batches until golden.Drain and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.Endor forest berriesBerries and mascarpone. Ewoks beat stormtroopers with rocks and logsHow to make it250g strawberries, halved125g blueberries200g pitted cherries2 tbsp honey1 small bunch mint250g mascarponeToss the strawberries, blueberries and cherries with some honey and torn mint.Whip the mascarpone with a spoon of honey until soft.Serve the fruit in a bowl with the mascarpone alongside.Salacious Crumb's crispy chicken bitesCrispy chicken bites, herb mayo. It's a trap!How to make itNot on tonight's cookButtermilk-brined chicken thigh nuggets in a garlic paprika crust, fried crisp and tossed in chilli salt, with a herby green mayo for dipping.Cut 700g chicken thighs into bite-size pieces and soak in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours.Mix 200g plain flour with 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika and pepper.Dredge the chicken and fry at 170°C for 5 minutes until crisp and cooked through.Toss in salt mixed with a pinch of chilli flakes.Blitz 120g mayo with a handful of parsley, chives and lemon juice for the dip.Second CourseEwok honey roast chickenHoney roast chicken. Han nearly ended up on the Ewoks' spitHow to make it1.8kg whole chicken800g potatoes4 carrots3 tbsp honey2 garlic cloves, crushed3 sprigs of thyme2 tbsp olive oilsalt and pepper, to tasteSpatchcock the chicken and cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks.Lay the chicken over the vegetables, season and drizzle with oil.Roast at 220°C.Warm the honey with the garlic and thyme, brush over and roast until glossy.Rest and pull apart to share.Jabba's Bantha fodder smoked brisketA big slab of everything, served before the Sarlacc pitHow to make itNot on tonight's cookSalt and pepper brisket smoked low until it wobbles, sliced thick with sticky barbecue sauce, tangy slaw, pickles and soft white bread.Rub a 2.5kg brisket with 2 tbsp coarse salt and 2 tbsp cracked pepper.Smoke or roast at 120°C for about 10 hours until 95°C inside, wrapping in baking paper once it reaches 70°C.Rest 1 hour.Shred quarter of a cabbage and 1 carrot and toss with 3 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp cider vinegar.Slice the brisket thick and serve with barbecue sauce, the slaw, dill pickles and white bread.Third CourseEwok forest berry crumbleMixed berry crumble with oats and hazelnuts, vanilla ice creamHow to make it750g frozen mixed berries80g caster sugar1 tbsp cornflour100g cold butter120g plain flour60g rolled oats50g hazelnuts, chopped100g brown sugar1 L vanilla ice creamHeat the oven to 180°C. Toss the berries with the caster sugar and cornflour in a baking dish.Rub the butter into the flour until crumbly, then stir in the oats, hazelnuts and brown sugar.Scatter over the berries and bake until golden and bubbling at the edges.Rest, then serve warm with vanilla ice cream.Fourth CourseBlue pineapple lime milkCold milk blended with pineapple, lime and blue spirulina, no alcoholHow to make it800ml full cream milk, cold200g frozen pineapple1 lime1/2 tsp blue spirulinaBlend the cold full cream milk, frozen pineapple, juice of the lime and blue spirulina until smooth and pale blue.Pour into four glasses and drink straight away.
